properties.name: frontend.url
properties.description: Frontend application URL used for CORS allowed-origins and OAuth2 redirect configuration.

properties.name: backend.url
properties.description: Backend base URL used for generating self-referencing links and OAuth2 callback URLs.

properties.name: oauth.google.client-id
properties.description: Google OAuth2 client ID(s) from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services, Credentials). Comma-separate several IDs (e.g. web, Android, iOS) to accept ID tokens issued to any of them.

properties.name: oauth.facebook.app-id
properties.description: Facebook OAuth2 app ID from Meta Developer Console.

properties.name: oauth.facebook.app-secret
properties.description: Facebook app secret, used to verify access tokens with /debug_token and to sign Graph API calls with appsecret_proof.

properties.name: oauth.github.client-id
properties.description: GitHub OAuth App client ID (GitHub, Settings, Developer settings, OAuth Apps).

properties.name: oauth.github.client-secret
properties.description: GitHub OAuth App client secret, used to exchange authorization codes and check access tokens.

properties.name: cloudinary.cloud-name
properties.description: Cloudinary account cloud name.

properties.name: cloudinary.api-key
properties.description: Cloudinary API key.

properties.name: cloudinary.api-secret
properties.description: Cloudinary API secret.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded secret key used to sign and verify JWT tokens. Must match across all services.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT token expiration duration in milliseconds. Default is 30 days (2592000000).

properties.name: rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute per client before rate limiting kicks in.

properties.name: email.support
properties.description: Support email address used as the sender for outgoing application emails.

properties.name: profile-views.max-history-size
properties.description: Maximum number of profile view history entries to retain per user.

properties.name: app.api-key
properties.description: Shared secret API key required on the X-API-Key header to access protected public endpoints (e.g. /profile/public/directory). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Set via the API_KEY environment variable in production — never commit the real value.

properties.name: spring.cloud.discovery.enabled
properties.description: Disables Spring Cloud service discovery (Eureka/Consul). Set to false when running without a service registry.

properties.name: google-drive.client-id
properties.description: OAuth client ID used with the refresh token to reach Google Drive.

properties.name: google-drive.client-secret
properties.description: OAuth client secret used with the refresh token.

properties.name: google-drive.refresh-token
properties.description: Refresh token with the drive.file scope for the Drive account that stores application documents.

properties.name: google-drive.service-account-file
properties.description: Path to a service account JSON key. Use instead of the refresh token for Workspace or shared folders.

properties.name: google-drive.folder-id
properties.description: Existing Drive folder to store applications in. Required with a service account; optional otherwise.

properties.name: google-drive.root-folder-name
properties.description: Name of the root folder created automatically when no folder id is set.

properties.name: home-owner-application.max-file-size-mb
properties.description: Largest accepted upload, in megabytes. Keep it below spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size.

properties.name: home-owner-application.max-documents
properties.description: Most files one application may hold.

properties.name: home-owner-application.review-sla-days
properties.description: Working days quoted to applicants as the usual review time.

properties.name: home-owner-application.frontend-path
properties.description: Frontend path the emails link to.

values.description: Suppresses hostname resolution warnings from Spring Cloud.
